purchase.strategy: Enrich existing verified-paid browser purchase only; no new purchase event/sender/conversion

safeFields.first_campaign_id: Decimal TEXT only and must be in03verified catalogue; unknown ids omitted, never coerced to numbers
safeFields.campaignNames: Free utm_campaign/content/term not retained or exported; names mapped by03from verified catalogue, not click ids
safeFields.origin_property_id: First tagged public landing property only, immutable thereafter; landing on home keeps property unknown even when later touch is another apartment

privateJoin.capture: Existing consent-gated Django session, first and last tagged touch/time/origin property and consent provenance; no raw click/browser ids retained
privateJoin.staffReport: Controlled optional staff source is labelled staff_reported; never promoted to a captured campaign
privateJoin.whatsapp: Server transition creates random non-secret capability-limited reference; hash stored privately; code only in WhatsApp prepared text and admin input; never dataLayer/page_location/referrer
privateJoin.linkEvidence: Link transition/prepared text does not prove message was sent or conversation closed; admin action records closure method
privateJoin.association: Explicit code entered by authorized admin; no name/email/phone matching; one code per booking anchor, expiry30days, no guest read/payment capability
privateJoin.binding: Existing quote->intent->reservation->verified payment relation, plus immutable private first/last snapshot; test/extension/revision separate

consent.revocation: Clear session capture on withdrawal; never replay denied actions or grant consent from admin reference
consent.export: Current non-staff guest analytics consent and valid captured consent/version for source tuple; no aa1fields on anonymous/denied purchase; no purchase event from staff browser
consent.capture: analytics consent required; current consent version and timestamp kept privately; late consent can capture current public landing only

dedup.strategy: Existing capture ledger for payment-link attempts in both routes, same attempt.amount/currency; reuse any older original reservation receipt identity/status; revisions are separately verified actual captures. No historical replay or second sender.
dedup.history: No historical purchase replay/backfill; missing historical campaign context remains unknown
dedup.transaction_id: Existing opaque non-reversible transaction id remains standard; no raw reservation/payment ids

scopeStatus: Private explicit binding covers regular admin overnight, morning and daytime anchors; GA4 enrichment reuses only existing verified payment receipt flow. Cash/bank and morning/daytime may be privately joined but no new server conversion sender is introduced.

campaignCatalogue.matchMeaning: Captured declared id in known account catalogue; NOT a Google matched click/conversion
campaignCatalogue.unknownId: Omitted from storage and GA4; source/medium may remain controlled, campaign unknown

evidenceSemantics: campaign_evidence qualifies LAST touch only; FIRST tuple is independently retained. tagged_id means captured catalogue-listed id, not provider confirmed attribution.

paidCoverage.regularHyperPay: Existing verified capture, production environment, paid request, confirmed non-test reservation, owned clean guest receipt; enrich existing purchase only
paidCoverage.staffBrowser: No browser purchase created/rendered/forwarded as a guest; staff may save private evidence only
paidCoverage.manualBankCash: Private source binding retained and joins existing recorded receipt evidence; no new server/offline conversion upload or staff-browser purchase
paidCoverage.morningDaytime: Private explicit source binding at creation; existing independent financial proof stays authoritative; no invented GA4 receipt/sender
paidCoverage.partial: Existing capture-scoped purchase semantics preserved; actual captured amount only and acquisition_kind=partial_payment, excluded from new-booking acquisition cohorts
paidCoverage.extensions: Existing child reservation classified stay_extension; not a new acquisition
paidCoverage.revisions: Existing modification link/payment classified payment_revision; no double sender
paidCoverage.tests: Production test reservations ineligible purchase; private test-environment evidence not treated as live acquisition
